title: Heavenly Father Is My Light
traveler_why: Beau is the brave one, and tonight’s psalm asks whom shall I fear: when the power goes out and the house goes dark, Beau remembers Heavenly Father is with him, takes a brave breath, finds the flashlight, and comforts his little sister.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because Heavenly Father’s light makes him brave. In Beau’s world today: the power went out and the whole house went dark, and Beau felt his heart jump. Then he remembered that Heavenly Father was with him, bright as any light. He took a brave breath, helped find the flashlight, and even comforted his little sister. Just like the psalm-writer said Heavenly Father is his light, Beau’s fear turned to brave.
